programme.title: थपकी प्यार की
programme.sub-title: Thapki, a lively and intelligent girl, faces certain problems that affect her life. However, she decides to move to a city in order to find a job and meet all her challenges with a positive attitude
programme.desc: एक समझदार लड़की थपकी उसके जीवन को प्रभावित करने वाली समस्याओं का सामना करती है। हालाँकि, वह नौकरी और सकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण से चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए शहर जाने का फैसला करती है।.

credits.actor: Jigyasa Singh,Manish Goplani,Ankit Bathla,Sheena Bajaj,Jaya Bhattacharya,Kritika Sharma,Abhinandan Jindal,Monica Khanna

programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा शेफ मन्नत, बड़े सपने देखती है लेकिन उसकी नियोक्ता ऐश्वर्या के रूप में उसके सामने बड़ी बाधा आती है। दोनों अंजान है, कि ऐश्वर्या मन्नत की माँ भी है जिसने उसे जन्म के समय छोड़ा था।.

programme.title: Friends

When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now

programme.desc: A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.
programme.title: Antz

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.
programme.title: Babe

programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs

programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore

programme.desc: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block.
programme.title: Charlotte's Web

programme.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.
programme.title: Jumanji

programme.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.
programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle

programme.desc: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.
programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level

programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.
programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.
programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer

programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

programme.desc: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.desc: S1 E1 — We Are At War Retraces the beginning of the German invasion of Poland and the segregation of the Jews. Mussolini joins Hitler in his fight against the Allies, Winston Churchill is appointed British Prime Minister, and Germany invades France.
programme.title: Hell on Earth: WWII

programme.desc: S1 E2 — We Shall Go On Autumn to Winter 1940 – 1941 Spring to Summer 1941 Germany continues to build its empire in Europe.
programme.title: Hell on Earth: WWII

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Darkness Falls As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.
programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Operation Torch In Operation Torch, the first joint US-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced US troops - and their untested leader Eisenhower - face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.
programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Langenburg Utilising the original audio from a witness over 50 years ago, we seek to understand what was seen in one of Canada's most notorious UFO sightings. Our team of experts discover there's more than just damaged crops at stake when they hypothesize that it was visitors from the exoplanet Kepler-442 b that landed on a small farm in 1974.
programme.title: UFO: POV

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Tinley Park Lights With over 160 different sightings, residents of the Chicago suburb of Tinley Park have got used to seeing the unexplained. The phenomena of the 'Tinley Park Lights' have caused many to question what they know as natural occurrences. Using exoplanet TOI-700 d to posit a theory of what these visitors may be looking for and what they are seeing, experts wonder if the UFO doesn't have nefarious aims?
programme.title: UFO: POV

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Egypt's Elite Experts unravel the mysteries of Ancient Egypt's Elite. Where is the lost tomb of Imhotep? And who was Ancient Egypt's first female pharaoh?
programme.title: Egypt's Unexplained Files

programme.desc: As the world edged toward another World War, Joe Louis and Max Schmeling's battles for boxing's heavyweight crown became symbols of a global showdown between FDR's vision of democracy and Hitler's violent fascism.
programme.title: The Clash of Nations: Joe Louis vs. Max Schmeling

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Double Cross When a camouflaged item intrigues everyone, the teams are forced to take desperate measures to win. Plus, Brandon and Lori make an unlikely alliance.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Once in a Lifetime The Berniers hunt down more potential bargains in storage lockers. A trio of RVs are up for sale, as well as some bronze statues and jet skis.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Naughty Hands & Crazy Pants Brandon goes for a bin of nude photos, which he thinks are valuable, while Lori is less than convinced. Kashuna gives them a run for their money.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E7 — Bowling for Billions Auction anarchy! Brandon and Scott hope to strike it lucky as they compete for ten-pin bowling equipment. T Money throws cash at a unit containing an ATM.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E9 — Now You See It Now You Don't All bets are off as the auction-goers battle for bargains in Las Vegas. Dustin continues to pose a threat to Brandon and Lori as mystery bins test their resolve.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S12 E9 — Let's Give 'Em Something to Tonka About Dave counts on his competition being unwilling to buy a big locker they need to move. Ivy and Ivy Jr. find their day somewhat therapeutic. Mary finally finds a tiny treasure to take home. Rene stands his ground to protect his honour.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E10 — Fowl Play Mary finds clothes that don't fit her, which turns out to be a good thing. Kenny takes a chance at being an early bird, but winds up looking more like a dodo.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E11 — What Came First: The Chicken or the Auction? Overwhelmed by the sheer number of units up for auction, Mary and Ivy wager that each can better predict final locker prices than the other. Dave's locker resembles a chop shop. Rene and Tatiana score vintage sporting goods.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E3 — A Sale of Two Cities Emily brings her mother along, as Darrell wastes no time finding an advantage. Ivy and Ivy Jr clean up with their locker and Kenny gets some advice from a music legend, while Shana and Edwina settle for thrifting what's in front of them.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E12 — The Wind Beneath My Bids Strong winds batter Desert Hot Springs, and the buyers do their best to keep standing. Rene and Gunther dust off an old locker. Brandi and Jarrod's unit takes a turn and ends up lapping the competition. Kenny steps up his game.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E13 — Not All That Glitters Is Gourd The Vegas ladies arrive in the city of Orange, California. Casey picks up a good unit and Darrell tries to make a sale to Emily, but ends up settling for a decent locker.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S21 E1 — Battle-Pawn Rick prepares for battle over a pair of vintage posters. Rick and Chum call on the power of Grayskull as they check out a large Battle Cat toy. Corey has a look at an old fireman's megaphone. Chum heads over to a photo gallery.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S21 E2 — The Pawnerator Rick sets his sights on a musket rifle from the 1800s. A seller tries to flex with a signed autobiography by Arnold Schwarzenegger. An old ventriloquist's dummy makes Corey and Rick's heads spin.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S21 E3 — Rarer Than Hen's Teeth Rick and Chum show off their pearly whites when a seller brings in a pair of Tyrannosaur teeth. Corey goes to bat for a signed Mark Buehrle jersey. A set of "M*A*S*H" action figures is on Rick's radar.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Mastermind When WWII breaks out between Britain and Germany, the Royal Navy must find a way to sink the German U-boats before they cut off their vital transatlantic shipping routes.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E2 — False Dawns Dönitz's U-boats continue to terrorise the transatlantic routes. In Britain, the WRENS prepare to frustrate his plans, while the Royal Navy turns to a retired wargamer.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E3 — The WRENS Though the Admiralty are convinced the Allies have the expertise to defeat Germany, Roberts and the Wrens start devising wargaming tactics to combat U-boat formations.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E4 — The Game Roberts and Laidlaw uncover a fatal flaw in the Royal Navy's anti-U-boat strategy, and develop their own countertactic. Their next task is winning over the Admiralty.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Stalemate Following a promotion, Dönitz now has the power to fill the Atlantic with more and more U-boats. The Battle of the Atlantic is about to reach a turning point when convoy ONS.5 catches Dönitz's attention.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E6 — The End Game When convoy ONS.5 enters the most perilous part of its journey, an area of the Atlantic that could not be reached by conventional air cover, Dönitz unleashes his wolf-packs.
programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers

programme.desc: S1 E1 — The First Viking Raid Tim Sutherland joins archaeologists as they uncover the realities of a Viking raid and conflicts with the English. Following the discovery of a mass grave in 2009, new questions are being asked about the settlers.
programme.title: Viking Dead

programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Viking Burial Ships of Estonia In Estonia, the earliest known Viking ships to have crossed the Baltic and the earliest examples of mass ship burials have been uncovered.
programme.title: Viking Dead

programme.desc: As the world edged toward another World War, Joe Louis and Max Schmeling's battles for boxing's heavyweight crown became symbols of a global showdown between FDR's vision of democracy and Hitler's violent fascism.
programme.title: The Clash of Nations: Joe Louis vs. Max Schmeling

programme.desc: Jesse Owens wins four gold medals at the 1936 Summer Olympics. An exploration into Owens' athletic dedication, perseverance and triumph over Hitler's Aryan supremacy agenda and his resilience against racism.
programme.title: Triumph: Jesse Owens and the Berlin Game

programme.desc: S6 E9 — Treasures of Monster Graveyard At a mysterious site in the Gobi Desert, experts discover a monster graveyard; the groundbreaking find contains the treasures of the alien beasts that once lived in this strange world.
programme.title: What on Earth?

programme.desc: S6 E10 — Episode 10 Satellites orbiting our planet have put more eyes on Earth's vast, unexplored areas of land and sea - revealing baffling new anomalies.
programme.title: What on Earth?

programme.desc: S21 E1 — Battle-Pawn Rick prepares for battle over a pair of vintage posters. Rick and Chum call on the power of Grayskull as they check out a large Battle Cat toy. Corey has a look at an old fireman's megaphone. Chum heads over to a photo gallery.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Grim Repear Scythe & Naval Boarding Axe Alec takes on two fearsome weapons: a brutal naval boarding axe and a humongous Grim Reaper Scythe. Both share a particularly risky forging technique.
programme.title: Forged with Steele

programme.desc: S18 E8 — The Need for Speed When a seller speeds into the shop with an iconic piece of Sammy Hagar memorabilia, Corey calls for back up; Rick has a chance to buy a vintage whiskey strap.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S18 E11 — Rick's Big Shot A seller comes in with an overcoat once owned by Lee Harvey Oswald; Corey checks out a 30-year-old Gibson guitar with a factory mistake; a rare Mike Tyson Nintendo game; Rick and Corey check out a restored WWII half-track.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: Pawn Shop Rock A tanto type of blade rumoured to have belonged to a Japanese World War II admiral commands Rick's attention.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S18 E13 — Rick's Surreal Supper When Chum gets his hands on a one-of-a-kind chair with a strange feature, will Rick turn a blind eye to his spending? Then, a helmet that once belonged to Evel Knievel lands in the shop.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S13 E11 — Older and Weiss-er Everything seems like business as usual in West Covina, until a crazy-looking vintage Mercury Zephyr pulls up, revealing an old friend. Darrell and his buddy stumble over the ultimate Sketch artist.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S13 E13 — Fears of a Clown It's a regular father and son shootout in Victorville, as Ivy and Pops try to prove who among them is the most profitable. Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for but luckily, Kenny is there to brighten her day.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S13 E15 — The Old Man and the Spree Kenny's fear of sharks inspires a controversial wardrobe choice; Rene brings his bargain army along to try and intimidate the competition, while he gets his slice of the loot; Darrell won't take no for an answer, moving full steam ahead.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S13 E17 — Not So Easy Rider Barry rolls up to Riverside with his own masked bidder, and the two develop a winning strategy. Brandi and Danielle's mystery balls take them to South America... sort of. Rene needs a cleanse after going through his risqué room.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S27 E10 — Popcorn Pickin' A first-time seller opens the doors to his time-capsule general store. Meanwhile, Mike pays a return visit to a Hollywood legend.
programme.title: American Pickers

programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Clue of the Hieroglyphs Crabtree and Murdoch discover a hieroglyphic journal next to the Mummy's latest victim and use it to decode a secret message that reveals their very lives are in danger. Queen Victoria plans a secret visit.
programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries: The Curse of the Lost Pharaohs

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Domestic Dangers A look back at when having a modern home meant living on the edge of danger. From backyard rubbish fires and waterbeds that turn bedrooms into flood zones, these are the familiar fixes and convenient comforts that turn out to be far from safe.
programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler

programme.desc: S18 E14 — That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles When a Mick Foley t-shirt and autographed mask come into the shop, Rick calls in a very special guest to authenticate it. Can he wrestle a superstar price, or end up getting slammed?
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S18 E15 — To Infinity and Be-pawned! Rick tries to win one from the Gipper when a special pendant hits the counter. Can the patron saint of pawn shops help Rick land the deal? Next, a massive collection of vinyl LPs has Chum's head spinning.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S18 E16 — Pawn Stars and Movie Stars Rick and Chum flip out when Spencer stops by the shop with a few vintage items; Rick calls in actor Dennis Quaid to help authenticate a signed poster for his upcoming movie.
programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.desc: S27 E3 — The Road to Relics Mike and Jersey go wild for an eclectic Kentucky stockpile. Mike steps up with a high-flying bid for the Holy Grail of vintage motorbikes.
programme.title: American Pickers

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
programme.desc: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. - 1972

programme.title: The Snakes
programme.desc: A woman's violent fantasies spiral out of control when she joins a neighborhood watch group. - 2021

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers to help him save Superman and the rest of the Justice League. - 2022

programme.title: Camp Hell
programme.desc: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. - 2010

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill. - 1995

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: In hiding for two decades, a traumatized woman (Jamie Lee Curtis) learns her murderous brother has returned for her. - 1998

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: Internet users watch six collegians as they spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home. - 2002

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. - 2024

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

programme.title: Cleaner
programme.desc: Hoping to expose corruption, radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. Their cause soon gets hijacked by an extremist within their ranks who's ready to kill everyone. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

programme.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
programme.desc: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Children, Science fiction) - 1992

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Doug MacRay leads a band of ruthless bank robbers and has no real attachments except for James, who -- despite his dangerous temper -- is like a brother. Everything changes for Doug when James briefly takes a hostage, bank employee Claire Keesey. Learning that she lives in the gang's neighborhood, Doug seeks her out to discover what she knows, and he falls in love. As the romance deepens, he wants out of his criminal life, but that could threaten Claire. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2010

programme.title: Carrie
programme.desc: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror) - 1976

programme.title: The Apparition
programme.desc: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

programme.title: The Meg
programme.desc: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

programme.title: Red Riding Hood
programme.desc: Young Valerie (Amanda Seyfried) feels torn between two men. She loves Peter, but her parents intend that she marry wealthy Henry. Valerie and Peter are going to run away together, but her sister is killed by a werewolf before they can put their plan into action. The villagers call on the help of Father Solomon (Gary Oldman), a famous monster hunter who warns that the beast takes human form by day. Then Valerie suspects that the werewolf is someone she loves. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Romance) - 2011

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
programme.desc: While still a boy, Abraham Lincoln loses his mother to a vampire's bite. He vows revenge, but fails in the attempt, narrowly escaping with his life. He is rescued by Henry (Dominic Cooper), a charismatic vampire hunter who instructs Abe in the fine art of dispatching bloodsuckers. Abe (Benjamin Walker) continues his fight against the undead well into adulthood and his presidency, making a last stand against the ultimate vampire foe (Rufus Sewell) on the eve of the Civil War's defining battle. (Action, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy) - 2012

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
programme.desc: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Based on the beloved Roald Dahl tale, this comedic and fantastical film follows young Charlie Bucket (Freddie Highmore) and his Grandpa Joe (David Kelly) as they join a small group of contest winners who get to tour the magical and mysterious factory of eccentric candy maker Willy Wonka (Johnny Depp). Aided by his diminutive Oompa Loompa workers (Deep Roy), Wonka has a hidden motivation for the tour, one that he will reveal only after the children in the group show their true colors. (Children, Fantasy, Comedy) - 2005

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
programme.desc: While still a boy, Abraham Lincoln loses his mother to a vampire's bite. He vows revenge, but fails in the attempt, narrowly escaping with his life. He is rescued by Henry (Dominic Cooper), a charismatic vampire hunter who instructs Abe in the fine art of dispatching bloodsuckers. Abe (Benjamin Walker) continues his fight against the undead well into adulthood and his presidency, making a last stand against the ultimate vampire foe (Rufus Sewell) on the eve of the Civil War's defining battle. (Action, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy) - 2012

programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

programme.title: Walkabout
programme.desc: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

programme.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
programme.desc: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

programme.title: Time Bandits
programme.desc: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana. - 2019

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world. - 2023

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. - 2024

programme.title: Broken City
programme.desc: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe). - 2013

programme.title: The Art of Getting By
programme.desc: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts). - 2011

programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: A Japanese detective (Pat Morita) and a Detroit detective (Jay Leno) team up to recover a stolen top-secret turbocharger. - 1989

programme.title: The Player
programme.desc: About 65 real-life movie stars fringe the satire of a Hollywood studio executive (Tim Robbins) who gets away with murder. - 1992

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: Five brief encounters occur in five taxis on the same night in Los Angeles, New York, Rome, Paris and Helsinki. - 1992

programme.title: The Man
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody. - 2005

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: A fast-talking literary agent (Eddie Murphy) must learn how to live without speech upon discovering that he has only a thousand words left to say before he dies. - 2012

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. - 2016

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet. - 2018

programme.title: Contagion
programme.desc: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days. - 2011

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Repo Men
programme.desc: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

programme.title: The Mountain Between Us
programme.desc: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
programme.desc: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

programme.title: Ricochet
programme.desc: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

programme.title: Chasing Mavericks
programme.desc: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

programme.title: All Eyez on Me
programme.desc: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

programme.title: Ocean's 11
programme.desc: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven

programme.desc: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang. - 1983

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million. - 1988

programme.title: Magnolia
programme.desc: Coincidence, divine intervention and fate link several people (Jason Robards, Julianne Moore, Tom Cruise) on an intense day which becomes a moral odyssey. - 1999

programme.title: The Last Samurai
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. (Adventure, Drama, War, Action) - 2003

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon. (Crime drama) - 1941

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

programme.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way. (Family, Holiday, Drama, Fantasy) - 2022

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He's depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him. (Holiday, Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 2003

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

programme.title: Love, Simon
programme.desc: Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old Simon Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing. (Romantic comedy, Drama, LGBTQ) - 2018

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time. (Musical comedy, Comedy) - 2017

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

programme.title: Road House
programme.desc: The Double Deuce is the meanest, loudest and rowdiest bar south of the Mason-Dixon Line, and Dalton (Patrick Swayze) has been hired to clean it up. He might not look like much, but the Ph.D.-educated bouncer proves he's more than capable -- busting the heads of troublemakers and turning the roadhouse into a jumping hot-spot. But Dalton's romance with the gorgeous Dr. Clay (Kelly Lynch) puts him on the bad side of cutthroat local big shot Brad Wesley (Ben Gazzara). (Action, Thriller) - 1989

programme.title: The Watchers
programme.desc: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
programme.desc: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2017

programme.title: Red Sparrow
